bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
git -C "$ROOT" remote get-url origin | grep -Eq 'GateApp-Bot(\.git)?$' || exit 61
git -C "$ROOT" cat-file -e 5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743^{commit} || exit 62
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
test -d "$WT" || exit 63
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = 5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743 || exit 64
if docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; else exit 65; fi
